scripts.build: node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @skali/shared build && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @skali/server build && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @skali/web build && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs build:helper
scripts.build:helper: dotnet publish tools/SkaliHelper -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o tools/SkaliHelper/publish
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web "node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @skali/server dev" "node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @skali/web dev"
